title: Quest NetVault Backup nvpmgr Integer Underflow Denial-of-Service Vulnerability.
desc:
Quest NetVault Backup nvpmgr Integer Underflow Denial-of-Service Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Quest NetVault Backup. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the nvpmgr service, which listens on UDP port 20031 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in an integer underflow before allocating a buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system. Was ZDI-CAN-28744.

title: Quest NetVault Backup StnzCreateKey Numeric Truncation Error Denial-of-Service Vulnerability.
desc:
Quest NetVault Backup StnzCreateKey Numeric Truncation Error Denial-of-Service Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Quest NetVault Backup. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the StnzCreateKey function. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a numeric truncation error before allocating a buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system. Was ZDI-CAN-28743.

title: An integer underflow in Zephyr's IPv4 option handling allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to read stack memory.
desc: An integer underflow in Zephyr's IPv4 option handling allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to read stack memory. When replying to an ICMP Echo Request that carries an IPv4 Record Route or Timestamp option, icmpv4_update_record_route() and icmpv4_update_time_stamp() in subsys/net/ip/icmpv4.c compute the length of the already recorded data as ptr - ptr_offset in uint8_t arithmetic. The attacker-controlled Pointer field is checked against the option length but not against the RFC 791 minimum (4 for Record Route, 5 for Timestamp), so a smaller value wraps the length to up to 252 bytes. net_pkt_write() then reads past the 40-byte opt_data stack buffer and up to 213 bytes of stack memory, which can include stack and heap pointers, are returned in the ICMP Echo Reply. A single packet triggers the leak and the device does not crash, so it can be repeated. Devices built with CONFIG_NET_IPV4_HDR_OPTIONS, which CONFIG_NET_IPV4_IGMP selects, are affected.

title: A vulnerability was determined in ToolJet up to 3.20.256-lts/3.21.93-beta.
desc: A vulnerability was determined in ToolJet up to 3.20.256-lts/3.21.93-beta. The impacted element is the function activateUserWithPassword of the file server/src/modules/onboarding/util.service.ts of the component Onboarding Signup Endpoint. Executing a manipulation of the argument email can lead to missing authentication. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. Upgrading to version 3.21.94-beta is sufficient to resolve this issue. This patch is called af8f17a745621ae418f1743440f63d315e8b8643. The affected component should be upgraded. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.

title: Data::Dump::Streamer versions before 3.00 for Perl allow code injection via unescaped Regexp patterns in _dump_qr.
desc:
Data::Dump::Streamer versions before 3.00 for Perl allow code injection via unescaped Regexp patterns in _dump_qr.

A Regexp's pattern is written into a qr literal without escaping "$" or "@", so "@{[ ... ]}" and "${\ ... }" in the pattern run as code when the dump is evaluated. An already escaped delimiter gets a second backslash, which leaves the delimiter bare and ends the qr literal early.

An attacker who supplies a pattern that an application compiles, dumps and later restores with eval or do can run arbitrary Perl code.

title: A flaw was found in the Konflux UI proxy.
desc: A flaw was found in the Konflux UI proxy. title: Philips Hue Bridge Pro SQL Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability.
desc:

Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed.

The specific flaw exists within the HTTP service, which listens on TCP port 443 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-33089.

An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to modify files in the context of the service account. Was ZDI-CAN-33090.

title: Missing release of memory after effective lifetime vulnerability in openEuler iSulad on Linux.
desc:
Missing release of memory after effective lifetime vulnerability in openEuler iSulad on Linux.

This vulnerability is associated with program file src/daemon/modules/spec/specs_mount.c.



This issue affects iSulad: through 2.1.6.



The memory leak vulnerability causes the iSulad daemon to be triggered frequently, exhausting the host machine's memory and ultimately leading to an OOM crash of the daemon, resulting in a denial of service (DoS).

title: Relative path traversal vulnerability in openEuler iSulad on Linux.
desc:
Relative path traversal vulnerability in openEuler iSulad on Linux.

This vulnerability is associated with program file src/daemon/modules/image/oci/oci_load.c.



This issue affects iSulad: through 2.1.6.



In oci_load.c, oci_load_process_manifest() does not sanitize the Config path of manifest.json. A malicious tar package can enable the isulad with the root permission to read any file on the host.

title: Use of Externally-Controlled format string vulnerability in openEuler iSulad on Linux.
desc:
Use of Externally-Controlled format string vulnerability in openEuler iSulad on Linux.

This vulnerability is associated with program file src/daemon/modules/image/oci/oci_load.c.



This issue affects iSulad: through 2.1.6.



When the iSulad daemon performs container lifecycle operations (such as create, start, exec, stop, etc.) through the isula runtime (shim), the daemon reads the stderr output of the shim process via a pipe for error information display. If the buffer contains format specifiers such as %s, %x, or %n, it may trigger a format string vulnerability, potentially leading to information leakage, denial of service, or the risk of arbitrary writes.

title: UNIX symbolic link (symlink) following vulnerability in openEuler iSulad on Linux.
desc:
UNIX symbolic link (symlink) following vulnerability in openEuler iSulad on Linux.

This vulnerability is associated with program file src/daemon/modules/spec/specs_mount.c.



This issue affects iSulad: through 2.1.6.



If an attacker can get the victim or the platform to run their crafted malicious image, they can cause the iSulad daemon to copy sensitive host directories into an anonymous volume when creating a container, which the container can then read.

desc: The Descope WordPress plugin before 1.2.0 does not validate the authentication token it receives before creating a WordPress session, accepting any non-empty token, so an unauthenticated attacker can obtain a session for any existing account, including an administrator, by supplying that account's email address.

desc: The Photo Gallery by 10Web  WordPress plugin before 1.8.49 does not escape a shortcode attribute that sets a gallery watermark image before rendering it into an HTML image attribute, and decodes percent-encoded characters in the value, allowing users with Contributor-level access and above to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting that executes in the browser of any user, including an administrator, who views the published gallery.

desc: The Crop Thumbnails WordPress plugin before 1.10.0 does not perform object-level authorization when reading and re-cropping media attachments, allowing any authenticated user with the upload capability (the Author role by default) to read the metadata of, and overwrite the generated thumbnail files and stored metadata of, media attachments belonging to other users.

title: The Oxygen MyData for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 3.0.9 does not have proper authorisation, nor validate the authenticity of the request, on one of its payment callbacks…
desc: The Oxygen MyData for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 3.0.9 does not have proper authorisation, nor validate the authenticity of the request, on one of its payment callbacks, allowing unauthenticated users to mark arbitrary WooCommerce orders as completed.

title: libilbm ILBM File Parsing Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability.
desc:
libilbm ILBM File Parsing Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of libilbm. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file.

The specific flaw exists within the parsing of ILBM files. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a heap-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process. Was ZDI-CAN-27792.
